Method of Attack: Consent phishing via malicious Office 365 OAuth applications
Application-based attack tricking targets into granting permissions to attacker-controlled OAuth apps
Stealing access and refresh tokens to take control of Microsoft accounts
Making API calls on behalf of victims through attacker-controlled apps
Stealing sensitive data from mail, files, contacts, SharePoint, and OneDrive for Business
Used in Business Email Compromise (BEC) fraud schemes
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with deceptive links prompting users to grant permissions to malicious OAuth apps
Indicators of Compromise: Domains used to host malicious Office 365 OAuth apps: officeinvetorys.com, officehnoc.com, officesuited.com, officemtr.com, officesuitesoft.com, mailitdaemon.com
